messages.content:
Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "0", "observation": "A high-pitched electronic chime sounds, followed by a sustained, mournful string melody with a slow, somber tempo."}, {"id": "15", "observation": "A synthesized musical melody plays, followed by a series of distinct electronic sound effects including clicks, chimes, and a final sustained tone."}, {"id": "30", "observation": "A high-pitched, sustained electronic tone is followed by a deep, resonant, and sustained musical drone."}, {"id": "210", "observation": "A lively, upbeat jazz piece featuring prominent brass, piano, and percussion, with a brief, sharp metallic impact sound."}, {"id": "255", "observation": "A lively orchestral piece featuring prominent brass and strings, with a steady rhythmic pulse and dynamic melodic interplay."}, {"id": "330", "observation": "A person opens a door, walks through, and closes it, followed by a brief musical jingle."}, {"id": "375", "observation": "A high-pitched electronic tone, followed by a piano melody, a door opening, and a loud, sharp impact sound."}, {"id": "420", "observation": "A sharp metallic impact is followed by a sustained, high-pitched electronic tone with a subtle, rhythmic mechanical whirring in the background."}]
